summary: The PR fixes a merge issue between dataset and dataarray, but introduces a potential performance regression due to the creation of a new dataset from the dataarray.

issues.description: The creation of a new dataset from the dataarray in the merge method may lead to performance issues for large datasets.
The approach of creating a new dataset from the dataarray may be brittle and not the most efficient way to handle the merge.
The PR does not include additional tests to cover the new merge functionality.
